still_standing.what_it_is_for: DeepSeek describes V4.1-Flash as the smallest model in a new architecture family, aimed at agent work, long context, and native image understanding at a lower cost than V4-Pro.

still_standing.name: Grok 4.5
still_standing.what_it_is_for: Coding and knowledge-work model launched 16 July 2026. Trained with Cursor on NVIDIA GB300 GPUs. It was the default in Grok Build at launch and is still on the October 2026 API price list at $2 / $6 per million tokens...

still_standing.name: Claude Sonnet 4
still_standing.what_it_is_for: Claude Sonnet 4 is the May 2025 Sonnet model, id claude-sonnet-4-20250514. Deprecated 2026-04-14 and retired 2026-06-15. Current list price remains USD 3/15 per million tokens. The deprecations page now names Sonnet 5...

still_standing.name: deepseek-chat
still_standing.what_it_is_for: deepseek-chat is a retired API id, not one set of weights. It tracked DeepSeek's general model from V2 through V3.2, then pointed at V4-Flash non-thinking mode, and was turned off after 24 Jul 2026.

still_standing.name: Mercury 2
still_standing.what_it_is_for: Inception built it for loops where latency stacks: coding and edit assistants, agent steps, real-time voice, and search or RAG. The launch claims quality competitive with speed-optimized frontier models, at more than...

still_standing.name: Claude Opus 4.7
still_standing.what_it_is_for: Claude Opus 4.7 is the April 2026 Opus model that introduced the newer tokenizer. It is still active as a legacy model. Fast mode is not accepted. The docs recommend Opus 5.5.

still_standing.name: Claude Opus 4.8
still_standing.what_it_is_for: Claude Opus 4.8 is a May 2026 Opus model still on the API as legacy. The docs point new work to Opus 5.5. Fast mode is offered at the same premium as Opus 5.

still_standing.name: Nemotron 3 Super
still_standing.what_it_is_for: NVIDIA positions Super for collaborative agents and workloads such as IT ticket automation, tool use, and long-context reasoning.

cheap_seat.name: Phi-4
cheap_seat.what_it_is_for: Microsoft describes Phi-4 as a small model for complex reasoning, math, and code, trained on synthetic data, filtered web text, and academic books and Q&A sets.

cheap_seat.name: Voxtral Small
cheap_seat.what_it_is_for: Our first model with audio input capabilities for instruct use cases.

cheap_seat.name: Amazon Nova Micro
cheap_seat.what_it_is_for: AWS positions it for high-volume, latency-sensitive text work: classification, routing, entity extraction, summarization, translation, and chat. It does not take images or video.

cheap_seat.name: Command R7B
cheap_seat.what_it_is_for: The smallest Command R model, for RAG, tools, and agents at low latency. It is Cohere's cheap self-serve chat model and has open weights.

cheap_seat.name: GPT-5 nano
cheap_seat.what_it_is_for: Fastest, most cost-efficient version of GPT-5

open_weighin.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
open_weighin.what_it_is_for: DeepSeek describes V4.1-Flash as the smallest model in a new architecture family, aimed at agent work, long context, and native image understanding at a lower cost than V4-Pro.

open_weighin.name: Nemotron 3 Super
open_weighin.what_it_is_for: NVIDIA positions Super for collaborative agents and workloads such as IT ticket automation, tool use, and long-context reasoning.

open_weighin.name: DeepSeek-V3
open_weighin.what_it_is_for: DeepSeek-V3 is the December 2024 MoE flagship. It was the deepseek-chat model, then updated in place by DeepSeek-V3-0324. Weights are still published. The first-party API no longer serves this generation.

open_weighin.name: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp
open_weighin.what_it_is_for: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp introduced DeepSeek Sparse Attention on 29 Sep 2025. It briefly was both deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner. V3.2 calls itself the official successor.

open_weighin.name: Hunyuan-A13B
open_weighin.what_it_is_for: Tencent presents it as an efficient general model for math, science, coding, long context, and tool-using agents.

headroom.name: MiMo-V2.6-Pro
headroom.what_it_is_for: Xiaomi recommends it for complex projects, long-horizon work, cybersecurity, and research, with text, image, video, and audio input.

headroom.name: Command R+ 08-2024
headroom.what_it_is_for: The August 2024 Command R+ refresh, still listed live on Cohere's API. It is the 128k RAG and tool-use model that Command A later replaced for most new work. Some clouds have retired their copies.

headroom.name: Kimi K2.6
headroom.what_it_is_for: Long-horizon coding, visual design from prompts, and agent work. The card describes an agent swarm of up to 300 sub-agents. The API also supports ordinary chat with thinking on or off.

headroom.name: Kimi K3
headroom.what_it_is_for: Moonshot positions it for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and deep reasoning, including tasks that mix software engineering with screenshots or video.

headroom.name: Command R 08-2024
headroom.what_it_is_for: The August 2024 Command R refresh, smaller and cheaper than Command R+. Cohere's index still lists it as live. Azure and Oracle have retired their hosted copies.
